messages.subject: extracting info from S4 classes
parts:
I'm writing a script to simulate sampling mussel populations while both accounting and not accounting for imperfect detection. I'm using unmarked to estimate occupancy (single season, single species, no co-variate). I'm simulating the sampling process 100 times and want to capture the occupancy estimate and standard error for each iteration and store them in an matrix for further manipulation. Here is a snippit of the code. I can provide the entire file if necessary. 

HA_estimate = numeric(100)#array to store 100 iterations of occupancy
 for (i in 1:100){
   data2 = reduced_detection_matrixA #uses package "unmarked" to calculate occupancy using single season model for reduced data
   X = sample(1:1000-R, 1)
   Z = X + R  #utilize random columns of detection matrix to calculate occupancy
   Y=data2[,X:Z]
   orig_detection2A = unmarkedFrameOccu(y = Y)
   fm2=occu(~1 ~1,orig_detection2A) #detection2A is matrix with 1000 columns of 1 and 0 representing detection
   HA = backTransform(fm2,'state')
   HA_estimate[i] = HA@estimate  #HA@estimate is estimate of occupancy
   #print (HA@estimate)
   #print(HA)
}

Output for HA is as follows: 

Backtransformed linear combination(s) of Occupancy estimate(s)

 Estimate     SE LinComb (Intercept)
     0.11 0.0313   -2.09           1

Transformation: logistic 

I can extract the Occupancy estimate as HA@estimate and store it but i can't find the corresponding value to extract SE. Any thoughts?

messages.subject: Re: extracting info from S4 classes
parts:
Hi Todd,

Calling

SE(HA)

should get you what you want.

Ken
